scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tighter font-black text-ink-900 leading-none
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl tracking-tight font-bold text-ink-900 leading-tight
scale.data-label: text-xs font-medium font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-ink-500

rules: Headlines > 32px must use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all data points, dates, timestamps, and state badges.
Never center-align long text or dense data; use optical left-alignment.
Jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Never use pure black (#000000) or pure white without structure.
Semantic states MUST ALWAYS combine color + shape + label. Never rely on color alone (WCAG 2.2 AA).
Use primary color sparingly for key CTAs and Mesh activity indicators.
Avoid teal or cyan in this light theme (reserved for future dark theme).
No generic soft shadows everywhere. Use crisp 1px borders.
The Atlas workspace uses full bleed background with floating glass panels over it.
Completely transparent backgrounds are FORBIDDEN on elements containing text over the Atlas.

global_header.layout: flex items-center justify-between h-14 px-4 bg-white border-b border-border z-50
elements: [Équipe/espace ▾]: Left-aligned, heavy Chivo font, subtle hover.
Navigation: Centered, transparent background, text-ink-600 hover:text-ink-900. Links: Actualités, Atlas, Travaux, Jumeaux, Administration.
[● Mesh vivant]: Pulsing semantic green indicator with tiny IBM Plex Mono timestamp.
[✦ Parler à Flore]: Right-aligned pill button, primary subtle background.

actualites_feed.layout: Bento-style or timeline layout. Max width container, left aligned.
elements: Navigation date ‹/›: Mono font header, large typography for Current Date.
Scopes: Tabs for Personnel / Mon espace / Mesh global.
Narrative Cards: Not generic social feeds. Dense, structured memory cards.
Actions: Clear 'Comprendre' and 'Voir dans l'Atlas' buttons.

travaux_cockpit.description: Replaces standard admin tables with a narrative, situation-focused workspace.
travaux_cockpit.style: Strict, technical, high-contrast borders. Grid-lines visible (border-collapse style).
travaux_cockpit.ai_integration: Reprise intelligente par Flore displayed as a distinctive inset panel with a subtle primary tint.

atlas_2d.background: Light dotted grid or subtle topographic lines on #F7F7F6.
atlas_2d.nodes: Sharp, angular nodes representing 'Territoires' and 'Jumeaux'. Colored by domain (pastels with dark ink text).
atlas_2d.toolbar: Floating glassmorphism panel at the bottom center. Controls: Lasso, Direct, Pause, Replay, Avant-Après, Historique.
atlas_2d.accessibility: Must include an 'Expliquer cette carte' button (WCAG screen reader summary).

flore_panel.content: Multi-turn conversation, active context visible at top, 'TrustBadges' for sources (small mono pill tags).

rules: Use generative spacing: 2-3x more spacing between distinct semantic sections.
Grid children must be direct children. Use align-items: start to prevent generic stretching unless intended.
Use optical alignment for icons + text (4px right padding vs 6px on all sides for left-icon buttons).

motion.philosophy: Calm, controlled, precise. No bouncing. No chaotic staggering.
motion.atlas: Smooth pan/zoom. State changes (Replay/Avant-Après) should crossfade elegantly.
rules: Never use 'transition: all' globally in CSS.

accessibility.contrast: Text against background must meet 4.5:1. Large text 3:1.
accessibility.semantic_state: All status indicators MUST have a visual shape and a text label, e.g., + Stable.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold: use the defined sharp borders, tight tracking for headings, and mono fonts for data.
No generic centered layouts. Optical left-alignment is strictly preferred.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, particularly for the Atlas and Flore panel.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; only use the specified 'glass' token.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='atlas-lasso-button').
For the Atlas map, maintain cartographic soul: subtle background grids, clear legends, floating controls.
Ensure all text is completely legible over the Atlas using proper background blurring or solid backgrounds.
The app must be entirely in French, reflecting an intelligent, calm, and highly professional enterprise decision platform.
